import pathlib, subprocess, json, hashlib, tarfile, io, base64, time, os
R=pathlib.Path('/home/name/Documents/420-EMBDX/A')
W=pathlib.Path('/home/name/.hermes/cache/scratch/mv-delivery')
T=W/'independent'
M=json.loads((W/'manifest.json').read_text())
LOG=W/'independent-review.log'; LEDGER=W/'independent-review.json'
def run(label,cmd,cwd=T,expect=0):
    start=time.monotonic()
    p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=cwd,shell=isinstance(cmd,str),capture_output=True,timeout=600)
    item=dict(label=label,command=cmd,cwd=str(cwd),status=p.returncode,expected=expect,seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start,3),stdout_b64=base64.b64encode(p.stdout).decode(),stderr_b64=base64.b64encode(p.stderr).decode())
    with LOG.open('ab') as f: f.write(('\n### '+label+'\n$ '+str(cmd)+'\nstdout:\n').encode()+p.stdout+b'\nstderr:\n'+p.stderr+('\nstatus: '+str(p.returncode)+'\n').encode())
    data=json.loads(LEDGER.read_text()) if LEDGER.exists() else {'executions':[]}
    data['executions'].append(item); LEDGER.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(label,p.returncode,item['seconds'],(p.stdout+p.stderr).decode(errors='backslashreplace')[-1800:],flush=True)
    if expect is not None: assert p.returncode==expect,label
    return p
if __name__=='__main__':
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=R).decode().strip()==M['base_head']
    assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=R)
    T.mkdir()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(subprocess.check_output(['git','archive',M['base_head']],cwd=R))) as tar: tar.extractall(T,filter='data')
    run('strict-source-whitespace',['git','apply','--check','--whitespace=error-all','--exclude=logs/commands/mv-execution.log',str(W/'ready.patch')])
    run('apply-reviewed-patch',['git','apply','--whitespace=nowarn',str(W/'ready.patch')])
    for group in ['delivered_files','unchanged_head_anchors']:
        for name,meta in M[group].items():
            p=T/name; d=p.read_bytes(); assert hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest()==meta['sha256'],name
            assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(d)).encode()+b'\0'+d).hexdigest()==meta['git_blob'],name
            assert ('100755' if p.stat().st_mode&0o111 else '100644')==meta['git_mode'],name
    (T/'build').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for dep in ['argtable3','cunit']: (T/'build'/dep).symlink_to(R/'build'/dep,target_is_directory=True)
    for name,meta in M['installed_dependencies'].items(): assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==meta['sha256'],name
    print('verified',len(M['delivered_files']),'delivery blobs',len(M['unchanged_head_anchors']),'anchors',len(M['installed_dependencies']),'dependencies',flush=True)
    run('normal-full','make -j2 all test test-mv')
    run('lint','make lint')
    run('scoped-format',['clang-format','--dry-run','--Werror','src/cmd_mv.c','src/cmd_mv.h','src/mv_main.c','src/registry.c','tests/test_mv_module.c','tests/test_shell_module.c'])
    run('global-format-inherited','make format-check',expect=2)
